description.value: Pizza Pizza is a Canadian pizza chain founded in 1967 with over 750 locations coast to coast, making it a familiar and reliable stop for hungry travellers. The Mission location sits along the Lougheed Highway and offers pizza, panzerottis, poutine, sandwiches, and sides for takeout or dine-in. Touring cyclists passing through Mission on Highway 7 will find it a straightforward refuelling option in a commercial strip.
